title: ConstellaLab simulation/visualization contract
description: Single versioned source for the data exchanged between the simulation core and any renderer. Conventions: lengths in kilometres, velocities in kilometres per second, angles in degrees, durations in seconds. Positions and velocities are expressed in a non-rotating Earth-centred inertial (ECI) frame whose axes are fixed at the scenario epoch; Earth rotation and precession are not modelled. `epoch_utc` is an ISO 8601 UTC instant (suffix Z); `simulation_time_s` counts simulated seconds since that epoch and is owned exclusively by the core. Optional fields may be omitted (defaults apply) but may not be null; unknown fields are rejected. Array position is never an identity: every entity carries a stable `id`. Compatibility rule: a payload is accepted when its schema_version has the same major version as this document and a minor version not greater than this document's.

SchemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the contract the payload was produced against.

EntityId.description: Stable, human-readable identifier. Never derive identity from array order.

UtcTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 instant in UTC with a mandatory Z suffix.

Vector3Km.description: Cartesian [x, y, z] in kilometres, ECI frame.

Vector3KmPerS.description: Cartesian [vx, vy, vz] in kilometres per second, ECI frame.

VersionMetadata.description: Identifies the component that produced a payload.

semi_major_axis_km.description: Semi-major axis; must exceed Earth's equatorial radius.

raan_deg.description: Right ascension of the ascending node.

true_anomaly_deg.description: True anomaly at the scenario epoch.

OrbitElements.description: Classical Keplerian elements referenced to the ECI frame at epoch. Illustrative two-body model; no perturbations.

time_scale.description: Simulated seconds advanced per real second while running.

SimulationClock.description: Canonical clock state. Only the core advances it; renderers display it.

SatelliteConfig.description: Initial definition of one virtual satellite (configuration, not runtime state).

seed.description: Master seed; must round-trip through IEEE doubles.

SimulationConfig.description: Everything needed to start a deterministic scenario. Contains no runtime state.

orbit.description: Osculating elements, when the producer tracks them.

SatelliteState.description: Runtime state of one satellite at the snapshot's simulation time.

SimulationSnapshot.description: Immutable view of the canonical simulation state. Renderers consume it as-is and never recompute positions.
